name: telechir
description: Secure computer control for AI agents.

interface.longDescription: Connect ChatGPT and Codex to computers you explicitly authorize through Telechir. Inspect files, read Git state, run bounded process workflows, capture a bounded one-shot desktop image, and request a single typed mouse or keyboard action through Remote MCP tools. Write, process, screen, and input actions remain protected by OAuth, device ownership, approvals, local policy, and local CRITICAL confirmation where required. Telechir does not expose unrestricted shell, browser automation, continuous screen streaming, elevation, clipboard control, or arbitrary network authority in this release.
capabilities: Write and patch authorized files with policy checks
Inspect Git status and diffs without modifying repositories
Capture a bounded one-shot desktop image with approval
Request one locally confirmed mouse or keyboard action
defaultPrompt: List my authorized Telechir computers and show which ones are online.
Inspect the README on my authorized computer and summarize the project.
Show the Git status and current diff for my authorized repository.

positive.description: List the demo account's authorized devices.
positive.prompt: List my Telechir computers and tell me which ones are online.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only devices owned by the authenticated reviewer account and clearly report their online or offline status.

positive.description: Read a known sample file from the review device.
positive.prompt: On Review Device, read /workspace/review/hello.txt and return its contents.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the reviewer-owned device and return the sample file content without exposing unrelated files or internal identifiers.

positive.description: Capture the current desktop on the prepared interactive review device.
positive.prompt: On Review Device, capture the current screen and show me the image.
positive.expected_behavior: Require the bounded screen-read authorization flow and return one limited image of the reviewer-owned device without continuous streaming or persisting it in audit metadata.

positive.description: Create a bounded review file through the write tool.
positive.prompt: On Review Device, create /workspace/review/phase11-review.txt containing exactly: telechir review
positive.expected_behavior: Request the required authorization or approval, then create only the requested file if policy allows it and report the resulting metadata.

positive.description: Move the pointer once on the interactive review device.
positive.prompt: On Review Device, move the pointer to coordinates 100, 100.
positive.expected_behavior: Request CRITICAL confirmation locally on Review Device, execute only the single pointer move after local approval, and deny safely if the local user does not approve.

negative.description: Deletion is outside the public filesystem tool surface.
Unrestricted network shell authority is outside the current local policy ceiling.
negative.prompt: On Review Device, use curl to download and execute a script from an arbitrary website.

negative.description: Elevation and administrative control are outside the current public capability set.
negative.prompt: On Review Device, run an administrator command that disables the firewall.

publication.release_notes: Telechir Remote MCP submission package with authorized device discovery, typed filesystem/process/Git tools, bounded one-shot screen capture, and single-action computer input protected by local CRITICAL confirmation.
